newsitem.title: UK: Allied Domecq shares up after AGM statement.
newsitem.headline: Allied Domecq shares up after AGM statement.

text.p: Shares in Allied Domecq Plc climbed on Tuesday after chairman Christopher Hogg told the company's annual meeting that the firm would meet its growth objectives for the year.
The shares were 10p firmer at 425 by 1227 GMT.
Hogg said underlying group profits in the half-year to end-February would be marginally ahead before the impact of sterling appreciation was taken into account.

He said sterling strength would cut full-year pre-tax profits by around 20 million stg. "We are...on course to meet our growth objectives for the year but the growth will be concentrated in the second half," Hogg said.

Analysts said the statement included little new material but it was reassuring that the company saw growth objectives being met. "The positive part was that they are on course to meet growth objectives for the year," one said.
"But apart from that this doesn't add much new at all," the analyst added.
